{{Otheruses|Omen}}
'''''Good Omen''''' was an [[Airship/Legends|airship]] in the [[Ebon Fleet]] maintained by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] on [[Keshtah Minor|Keshtah]], a continent on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. The [[Grand Lord]] of the Tribe, [[Varner Hilts]], rode aboard the ''Good Omen'' as it traversed the [[Western Sea (Kesh)|Western Sea]] to arrive at the continent of [[Alanciar]]. Upon disembarking, Hilts, dressed as the [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] deity the [[Bright Tuash]], welcomed the [[Alanciari]] [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] into the Tribe and ended the [[invasion of Alanciar]] in peace.
